ex.en: They're fast runners.
ex.zh: 他們跑得很快。

ex.en: The two runners reached the finish line at the same time.
ex.zh: 兩名跑者同時抵達終點線。

ex.en: Tom is the fastest runner out of the three of us.
ex.zh: 湯姆是我們三個人當中跑得最快的。

runner.en: a person who runs, especially in a race

ex.en: Rubber is not hard: it gives way to pressure.
ex.zh: 橡膠不硬：受到壓力就會變形。

ex.en: This isn't rubber.
ex.zh: 這不是橡膠。

ex.en: These boots are made of rubber.
ex.zh: 這雙靴子是橡膠做的。

rubber.en: a soft, stretchy material used to make tires, balls and erasers

ex.en: Can I borrow your rubber?
ex.zh: 可以借我你的橡皮擦嗎？

ex.en: I need a pencil and a rubber.
ex.zh: 我需要一支鉛筆和一塊橡皮擦。

rubber.en: a small tool used to remove pencil marks (British English)

ex.en: He never stepped on that rug.
ex.zh: 他從沒踩過那塊地毯。

ex.en: This rug is handmade.
ex.zh: 這塊地毯是手工做的。

ex.en: We put a new rug in the living room.
ex.zh: 我們在客廳鋪了一塊新地毯。

rug.en: a small piece of thick cloth that covers part of a floor

rug.zh: sweep (something) under the rug：掩蓋、隱瞞（問題）

ex.en: The company tried to sweep the problem under the rug.
ex.zh: 公司試圖把問題掩蓋起來。

ex.en: Don't sweep your mistakes under the rug.
ex.zh: 別把你的錯誤隱瞞起來。

rug.en: to hide a problem so that people do not talk about it

ex.en: Draw a line with a ruler.
ex.zh: 用尺畫線。

ex.en: Can I borrow your ruler?
ex.zh: 我可以借你的尺嗎？

ruler.en: a flat tool with marks on it, used to measure or draw straight lines

ex.en: The king was a wise ruler.
ex.zh: 那位國王是個英明的統治者。

ex.en: The country's rulers ignored the people's needs.
ex.zh: 這個國家的統治者忽視了人民的需求。

ruler.en: a person who has the power to govern a country or area

ex.en: He runs every day so he is very healthy.
ex.zh: 他每天跑步，所以身體很健康。

ex.en: A dog can run faster than a man can.
ex.zh: 狗跑得比人快。

run.en: to move on foot faster than walking

ex.en: She runs a small café.
ex.zh: 她經營一家小咖啡館。

ex.en: Who runs this company?
ex.zh: 這家公司是誰在經營？

run.en: to be in charge of a business or group

ex.en: The app runs on both iPhone and Android.
ex.zh: 這個 App 在 iPhone 和 Android 上都能執行。

ex.en: The buses run every ten minutes.
ex.zh: 公車每十分鐘一班。

run.en: to work or operate, or to travel on a regular route

ex.en: Nancy ran across an old friend of hers yesterday.
ex.zh: 南西昨天巧遇了她的一位老朋友。

ex.en: I ran across an old friend near the bank.
ex.zh: 我在銀行附近碰到一位老朋友。

run.en: to meet or find someone or something by chance

ex.en: We've run out of paper.
ex.zh: 我們的紙用完了。

ex.en: My phone is running out of battery.
ex.zh: 我的手機快沒電了。

run.en: to use all of something so that none is left

ex.en: The rules must be few and, more importantly, simple.
ex.zh: 規則要少，更重要的是要簡單。

ex.en: Every player is under obligation to keep the rules.
ex.zh: 每位選手都有義務遵守規則。

ex.en: The rule of the road must be strictly observed.
ex.zh: 交通規則必須嚴格遵守。

rule.en: an official statement about what people must or must not do

rule.zh: as a rule / make it a rule to：通常；習慣

ex.en: I make it a rule to keep early hours.
ex.zh: 我習慣早睡早起。

ex.en: As a rule, I don't work on weekends.
ex.zh: 我通常週末不工作。

rule.en: usually, or as a fixed habit that you follow

ex.en: The court ruled in favor of the company.
ex.zh: 法院做出對該公司有利的判決。

ex.en: The king ruled the country for 40 years.
ex.zh: 國王統治這個國家四十年。

rule.en: to govern a country, or to make an official decision

ex.en: The IMF ruled out any new loans to that country.
ex.zh: 國際貨幣基金組織排除了再貸款給該國的可能。

ex.en: We can't rule out the possibility of delays.
ex.zh: 我們不能排除延誤的可能。

rule.en: to decide that something is not possible or will not be done

ex.en: He rushed into the room with his coat on.
ex.zh: 他穿著外套衝進房間。

ex.en: She rushed home with the good news.
ex.zh: 她帶著好消息急忙跑回家。

rush.en: to move or go somewhere very quickly

ex.en: This thing can't be rushed; it needs long-term planning.
ex.zh: 這件事急不得，需要長遠規劃。

ex.en: Don't rush me. I need time to think.
ex.zh: 別催我，我需要時間想一想。

rush.en: to make someone hurry, or to do something too quickly

ex.en: I'm in a rush, so I'll call you later.
ex.zh: 我在趕時間，晚點再打給你。

ex.en: There's no rush. Take your time.
ex.zh: 不急，慢慢來。

rush.en: a hurry, or a sudden quick movement

ex.en: The busses are especially crowded during rush hour.
ex.zh: 上下班尖峰時段公車特別擠。

ex.en: There ought to be more buses during the rush hours.
ex.zh: 尖峰時段應該要有更多公車。

rush.en: the busy time of day when many people travel to or from work

ex.en: It seems the rural area will be developed on a large scale.
ex.zh: 看來農村地區將被大規模開發。

ex.en: Asia has many rural villages.
ex.zh: 亞洲有許多鄉村。

ex.en: Many young people leave rural areas to find work.
ex.zh: 許多年輕人離開鄉下到外地找工作。

rural.en: related to the countryside and not to towns or cities

ex.en: The two of you have ruined my life.
ex.zh: 你們兩個毀了我的人生。

ex.en: This scandal will likely ruin your chances of being elected.
ex.zh: 這樁醜聞很可能毀掉你當選的機會。

ex.en: The rain ruined our picnic.
ex.zh: 這場雨毀了我們的野餐。

ruin.en: to spoil or destroy something completely

ex.en: A series of blasts reduced the laboratory to ruins.
ex.zh: 一連串的爆炸把實驗室夷為廢墟。

ex.en: There is an important ruin hidden under this gym.
ex.zh: 這座體育館底下藏著一處重要遺址。

ruin.en: the broken parts left of a building that has been destroyed

ex.en: She rubbed her eyes.
ex.zh: 她揉了揉眼睛。

ex.en: Never rub your eyes when your hands are dirty.
ex.zh: 手髒的時候千萬不要揉眼睛。

ex.en: Rub some lotion on your hands.
ex.zh: 在手上抹一些乳液。

rub.en: to press and move your hand or an object over a surface

ex.en: Those two communicate a lot with each other at work, often rubbing shoulders.
ex.zh: 他們倆工作上常聯絡，經常打交道。

ex.en: At the conference, I rubbed shoulders with industry leaders.
ex.zh: 我在研討會上和業界領袖有所交流。

rub.en: to spend time with and meet people, especially important ones

rub.zh: rub it in：哪壺不開提哪壺、一再提起（別人的錯）

ex.en: I know I made a mistake, so don't rub it in.
ex.zh: 我知道我犯錯了，別再一直提了。

ex.en: Stop rubbing it in!
ex.zh: 別再哪壺不開提哪壺了！

rub.en: to keep reminding someone of a mistake or failure that upsets them

ex.en: It is rude to talk when your mouth is full.
ex.zh: 邊吃東西邊談話是非常沒有禮貌的。

ex.en: It's rude to make fun of your boss in public.
ex.zh: 在公開場合開你老闆的玩笑是無禮的。

ex.en: It is rude of you to say so.
ex.zh: 你這麼說很失禮。

rude.en: not polite, and likely to upset other people

rumble.zh: 發出隆隆聲；（肚子）咕嚕叫

ex.en: Your stomach has been rumbling for quite a while now. Are you sure you're all right?
ex.zh: 你的肚子已經咕嚕咕嚕叫了好一陣子，你確定沒事嗎？

ex.en: We heard thunder rumbling in the distance.
ex.zh: 我們聽到遠處雷聲隆隆。

rumble.en: to make a long, low sound

ex.en: The rumble of trucks on the highway kept me awake.
ex.zh: 高速公路上卡車的隆隆聲讓我睡不著。

ex.en: We felt a low rumble just before the earthquake started.
ex.zh: 就在地震開始前，我們感覺到一陣低沉的轟隆聲。

ex.en: There is a rumor that he has resigned.
ex.zh: 有傳言說他辭職了。

ex.en: It turned out that the rumor was false.
ex.zh: 結果那個謠言是假的。

ex.en: They say you shouldn't take rumors seriously, but that's easier said than done.
ex.zh: 大家都說不要把謠言當真，但說起來容易做起來難。

rumor.en: a story that many people tell but that may not be true

ex.en: The flight was delayed while crews inspected the runway.
ex.zh: 工作人員檢查跑道時，航班因此延誤。

ex.en: The designer sent the collection down the runway in March.
ex.zh: 設計師在三月讓這系列服裝登上伸展台。

runway.en: a long, flat strip where planes take off and land, or where models walk at a show

ex.en: The busses are especially crowded during rush hour.
ex.zh: 尖峰時段公車特別擠。

ex.en: If we don't hit the road soon, we'll get caught in the morning rush hour traffic.
ex.zh: 如果我們不趕快出發，就會碰上早上的尖峰車潮。

ex.en: It was the morning rush hour, and there were a lot of passing pedestrians and cars.
ex.zh: 當時正是早上尖峰時間，路上行人和車輛很多。

rush hour.en: the busy time of day when many people travel to or from work

ex.en: He plays rugby for his university team.
ex.zh: 他在大學的球隊打橄欖球。

ex.en: We watched a rugby match on TV last night.
ex.zh: 我們昨晚在電視上看了一場橄欖球比賽。

ex.en: Please put the rubbish in the bin outside.
ex.zh: 請把垃圾丟到外面的垃圾桶。

ex.en: The streets were full of rubbish after the festival.
ex.zh: 慶典結束後，街上滿是垃圾。

ex.en: Don't talk rubbish, you know that isn't true.
ex.zh: 別胡說八道，你知道那不是真的。

ex.en: I think the whole story is complete rubbish.
ex.zh: 我覺得整個故事根本是一派胡言。

ex.en: Running every morning keeps me healthy.
ex.zh: 每天早上跑步讓我保持健康。

ex.en: She bought new shoes for running.
ex.zh: 她買了一雙新的跑步鞋。

ex.en: He is in charge of the running of the shop.
ex.zh: 他負責這家店的經營。

ex.en: The smooth running of the machine saves us a lot of time.
ex.zh: 機器運轉順暢替我們省下許多時間。

ex.en: The cabin has no running water.
ex.zh: 那間小屋沒有自來水。

ex.en: It rained for three days running.
ex.zh: 雨連續下了三天。

ex.en: The court's ruling surprised many people.
ex.zh: 法院的裁決讓許多人很驚訝。

ex.en: The referee's ruling was that the goal did not count.
ex.zh: 裁判裁定那顆進球不算。

ex.en: The ruling party won most of the seats.
ex.zh: 執政黨贏得了大部分席次。

ex.en: The ruling family lived in the old castle.
ex.zh: 統治家族住在古老的城堡裡。

ex.en: There is a rumour that the company will move abroad.
ex.zh: 有傳聞說這家公司將搬到國外。

ex.en: Don't believe every rumour you hear online.
ex.zh: 別相信你在網路上聽到的每一個傳言。

ex.en: It is rumoured that the singer will retire next year.
ex.zh: 謠傳這位歌手明年將引退。

ex.en: The new shop is rumoured to open next month.
ex.zh: 據傳這家新店下個月開幕。

ex.en: My roommate is a Russian who studies physics.
ex.zh: 我的室友是個念物理的俄國人。

ex.en: She is learning Russian so she can read old novels.
ex.zh: 她正在學俄語，好讀懂古老的小說。

ex.en: The Russian winter can be extremely cold.
ex.zh: 俄國的冬天可能極為寒冷。

ex.en: He enjoys listening to Russian music in the evening.
ex.zh: 他喜歡晚上聽俄國音樂。

ex.en: Russia is the largest country in the world by area.
ex.zh: 以面積來說，俄羅斯是世界上最大的國家。

ex.en: Russia stretches across both Europe and Asia.
ex.zh: 俄羅斯橫跨歐洲和亞洲。

ex.en: Ruth baked a lemon cake for her neighbor's birthday.
ex.zh: 露絲為鄰居的生日烤了一個檸檬蛋糕。

ex.en: I sat next to Ruth during the whole movie.
ex.zh: 整場電影我都坐在露絲旁邊。

ex.en: We drove along a rugged coast with steep cliffs.
ex.zh: 我們沿著有陡峭懸崖的崎嶇海岸開車。

ex.en: The rugged mountain path was hard to climb.
ex.zh: 那條崎嶇的山路很難爬。

ex.en: He bought a rugged phone case that can survive a fall.
ex.zh: 他買了一個摔不壞的堅固手機殼。

ex.en: These rugged boots are made for long hikes.
ex.zh: 這雙耐用的靴子是為長途健行設計的。

ex.en: The actor has a rugged face and a deep voice.
ex.zh: 這位演員有著粗獷的臉孔和低沉的嗓音。

ex.en: He looked rugged and tanned after months at sea.
ex.zh: 在海上待了數月後，他看起來粗獷又曬得黝黑。

ex.en: Rescuers searched through the rubble for survivors.
ex.zh: 救難人員在瓦礫堆中搜尋生還者。

ex.en: The old building was reduced to a pile of rubble.
ex.zh: 那棟老建築被夷為一堆瓦礫。

ex.en: Rain runoff flooded the street.
ex.zh: 雨水徑流淹沒了街道。

ex.en: Farm runoff can pollute rivers.
ex.zh: 農田的排水可能污染河川。

ex.en: No candidate won enough votes, so there will be a runoff.
ex.zh: 沒有候選人得到足夠票數，所以會舉行決選。

ex.en: She won the runoff election by a small margin.
ex.zh: 她在決選中以些微差距獲勝。

ex.en: The ruthless boss fired people without warning.
ex.zh: 那位冷酷的老闆毫無預警地開除員工。

ex.en: Competition in this industry is ruthless.
ex.zh: 這個行業的競爭非常殘酷。

ex.en: He poured a little rum into the cake mixture.
ex.zh: 他在蛋糕麵糊裡倒了一點蘭姆酒。

ex.en: Rum is made from sugar cane.
ex.zh: 蘭姆酒是用甘蔗製成的。

ex.en: The old bike had a rusty chain.
ex.zh: 那輛舊腳踏車的鏈條生鏽了。

ex.en: He found a rusty key in the garden.
ex.zh: 他在花園裡發現一把生鏽的鑰匙。

ex.en: My French is rusty because I haven't used it for years.
ex.zh: 我的法語很生疏，因為好多年沒用了。

ex.en: The pianist felt rusty after a long break.
ex.zh: 那位鋼琴家休息很久之後覺得琴藝生疏了。

ex.en: We stayed in a rustic cabin near the lake.
ex.zh: 我們住在湖邊一間質樸的小木屋。

ex.en: The restaurant has a rustic charm with wooden tables.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳有木頭桌子，帶著鄉村風情。

ex.en: The city people laughed at the rustic who didn't know the subway.
ex.zh: 城裡人嘲笑那個不會搭地鐵的鄉下人。

ex.en: In the old story, a rustic wins the princess by being kind.
ex.zh: 在古老的故事裡，一位鄉下人憑著善良贏得了公主。

ex.en: The runaway horse ran through the village.
ex.zh: 那匹脫韁的馬跑過整個村子。

ex.en: A runaway truck rolled down the hill.
ex.zh: 一輛失控的卡車從山坡上滑下來。

ex.en: The police found the runaway at the bus station.
ex.zh: 警方在公車站找到了那名離家出走的人。

ex.en: The shelter gives food to runaways in winter.
ex.zh: 這個收容所在冬天提供食物給離家出走的孩子。

ruined.zh: 毀掉、搞砸（ruin 的過去式）

ex.en: The heavy rain ruined our picnic.
ex.zh: 大雨毀了我們的野餐。

ex.en: He ruined his shirt by washing it with a red sock.
ex.zh: 他把襯衫和一隻紅襪子一起洗，結果毀了襯衫。

ex.en: We explored a ruined castle on the hill.
ex.zh: 我們探索了山丘上一座殘破的城堡。

ex.en: The ruined walls were covered in green vines.
ex.zh: 那些殘破的牆壁爬滿了綠色藤蔓。

ex.en: The old bicycle was covered in rust.
ex.zh: 那輛舊腳踏車布滿了鏽。

ex.en: Rust had eaten through the bottom of the bucket.
ex.zh: 鏽蝕把水桶底部都腐蝕穿了。

ex.en: Iron will rust if you leave it in the rain.
ex.zh: 鐵放在雨中就會生鏽。

ex.en: The gate had begun to rust because of the salty sea air.
ex.zh: 因為海風帶鹽分，大門已經開始生鏽了。

ex.en: I feel like I'm in a rut at my job.
ex.zh: 我覺得自己在工作上陷入了一成不變的窠臼。

ex.en: A short trip can help you get out of a rut.
ex.zh: 一趟短旅行能幫你跳出千篇一律的生活。

ex.en: The truck got stuck in a deep rut in the mud.
ex.zh: 卡車陷在泥地裡一道很深的車轍中。

ex.en: Rain filled the ruts on the dirt road.
ex.zh: 雨水積滿了泥土路上的車轍。

ex.en: She rummaged through her bag for the keys.
ex.zh: 她在包包裡翻找鑰匙。

ex.en: The kids rummaged in the attic and found old toys.
ex.zh: 孩子們在閣樓裡翻找，找到一些舊玩具。

ex.en: After a quick rummage in the drawer, he found the tape.
ex.zh: 他在抽屜裡匆匆翻了一下就找到了膠帶。

ex.en: Have a rummage around and see what you can find.
ex.zh: 到處翻翻看，看你能找到什麼。

ex.en: The farmer patted the horse on its rump.
ex.zh: 農夫輕拍馬的臀部。

ex.en: We ordered a rump steak for dinner.
ex.zh: 我們晚餐點了一份後臀肉牛排。

ex.en: He has only a rudimentary knowledge of French.
ex.zh: 他只有基礎的法語知識。

ex.en: The camp had rudimentary tools and a small tent.
ex.zh: 營地只有簡陋的工具和一頂小帳篷。

ex.en: He was rushing to catch the last train.
ex.zh: 他正趕著搭末班車。

ex.en: Stop rushing and take your time with the homework.
ex.zh: 別趕了，慢慢寫功課。

ex.en: People were rushing out of the building during the alarm.
ex.zh: 警報響起時，人們正衝出大樓。

ex.en: The nurse is rushing the patient to the hospital room.
ex.zh: 護理師正把病患急速送往病房。

ex.en: We heard the rushing water of the river nearby.
ex.zh: 我們聽到附近河水湍急的聲音。

ex.en: The rushing stream carried leaves downhill.
ex.zh: 湍急的溪流把落葉沖往下游。

ex.en: He packed a rucksack for the two-day hike.
ex.zh: 他為兩天的健行收拾了一個後背包。

ex.en: The child carried a small rucksack to school.
ex.zh: 那孩子揹著一個小後背包去上學。

ex.en: He ruefully admitted that he had forgotten her birthday.
ex.zh: 他懊悔地承認自己忘了她的生日。

ex.en: She looked ruefully at the broken cup on the floor.
ex.zh: 她帶著懊惱的神情看著地上破掉的杯子。

ex.en: The wind ruffled her hair as she walked along the beach.
ex.zh: 她走在海邊時，風把她的頭髮吹亂了。

ex.en: Nothing seems to ruffle him, even when things go wrong.
ex.zh: 就算事情出錯，似乎也沒什麼能惹惱他。

ex.en: The dress has a pretty white ruffle around the collar.
ex.zh: 這件洋裝的領口有一圈漂亮的白色荷葉邊。

ex.en: She sewed a ruffle onto the edge of the curtain.
ex.zh: 她在窗簾邊緣縫上一道荷葉邊。

ex.en: The leaves rustled in the evening breeze.
ex.zh: 樹葉在傍晚的微風中沙沙作響。

ex.en: I heard something rustle in the bushes behind me.
ex.zh: 我聽到身後的灌木叢裡有東西沙沙作響。

ex.en: There was a soft rustle of paper as she opened the gift.
ex.zh: 她拆禮物時發出紙張輕輕的沙沙聲。

ex.en: We heard the rustle of leaves under our feet.
ex.zh: 我們聽到腳下落葉的沙沙聲。

ex.en: She wore a ring with a large ruby.
ex.zh: 她戴著一枚鑲有大顆紅寶石的戒指。

ex.en: The ruby sparkled in the museum's display case.
ex.zh: 那顆紅寶石在博物館的展示櫃裡閃閃發光。

ex.en: She painted her lips a deep ruby red.
ex.zh: 她把嘴唇塗成深紅寶石色。

ex.en: The sun set in a ruby sky.
ex.zh: 太陽在一片深紅的天空中落下。

ex.en: The captain turned the rudder to steer the boat left.
ex.zh: 船長轉動舵，讓船向左轉。

ex.en: A broken rudder made the ship hard to control.
ex.zh: 舵壞了，讓船很難操控。

ex.en: The teacher gave us a rubric for grading the essay.
ex.zh: 老師給了我們這篇文章的評分標準。

ex.en: Check the rubric before you hand in your report.
ex.zh: 交報告之前先對照評分標準。

ex.en: The article falls under the rubric of public health.
ex.zh: 這篇文章屬於公共衛生這一類別。

ex.en: Each section has a rubric in red letters.
ex.zh: 每個段落都有一個紅字標題。

rune.zh: 盧恩字母（古代北歐文字）

ex.en: The stone was carved with ancient runes.
ex.zh: 那塊石頭上刻著古老的盧恩文字。

ex.en: He studied how Vikings used runes to write short messages.
ex.zh: 他研究維京人如何用盧恩字母書寫簡短訊息。

rusted.zh: （使）生鏽（rust 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: The old bicycle had rusted after years in the rain.
ex.zh: 那輛舊腳踏車在雨中放了好幾年，已經生鏽了。

ex.en: The gate rusted shut because nobody oiled it.
ex.zh: 沒人上油，那扇門鏽死打不開了。

rung.zh: 按鈴；響（ring 的過去分詞）

ex.en: The bell has rung, so please take your seats.
ex.zh: 鈴聲已經響了，請大家就座。

ex.en: I wish I had rung her earlier to say thank you.
ex.zh: 我真希望早點打電話向她道謝。

ex.en: Be careful, the top rung of the ladder is loose.
ex.zh: 小心，梯子最上面那一階鬆了。

ex.en: He put his foot on the bottom rung and started climbing.
ex.zh: 他把腳踩在最下面那一階，開始往上爬。

ex.en: A pipe rupture flooded the basement.
ex.zh: 水管破裂讓地下室淹水了。

ex.en: The argument led to a rupture between the two friends.
ex.zh: 那場爭吵導致兩位朋友關係破裂。

ex.en: The old water tank could rupture at any time.
ex.zh: 那個舊水塔隨時可能破裂。

ex.en: The heavy load ruptured the bag.
ex.zh: 沉重的東西把袋子撐破了。

ex.en: The company ruthlessly cut jobs to save money.
ex.zh: 公司為了省錢，無情地裁員。

ex.en: He ruthlessly pushed aside anyone who got in his way.
ex.zh: 他冷酷地排擠任何擋他路的人。

ex.en: You will rue the day you ignored this advice.
ex.zh: 你會為忽視這個建議的那一天感到後悔。

ex.en: She rued her decision to quit so early.
ex.zh: 她後悔自己太早放棄的決定。

ex.en: He looked back on his mistake with deep rue.
ex.zh: 他懷著深深的懊悔回顧自己的錯誤。

ex.en: To her rue, the offer was gone by morning.
ex.zh: 令她懊悔的是，隔天早上那個機會就沒了。

ex.en: Can you give me a quick rundown of what happened at the meeting?
ex.zh: 你可以簡單跟我說明一下會議的重點嗎？

ex.en: The guide gave us a rundown of the day's schedule.
ex.zh: 導遊為我們簡要說明了當天的行程。

ex.en: They lived in a rundown apartment near the station.
ex.zh: 他們住在車站附近一間破舊的公寓。

ex.en: After weeks of overtime, he felt tired and rundown.
ex.zh: 連續加班好幾週後，他覺得又累又虛弱。

ex.en: We heard a low rumbling in the distance before the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨來臨前，我們聽見遠處傳來低沉的隆隆聲。

ex.en: The rumbling of the train shook the old house.
ex.zh: 火車的隆隆聲震動了這棟老房子。

ex.en: He had a ruddy face from working outdoors.
ex.zh: 他因為在戶外工作，臉色紅潤。

ex.en: The children came in with ruddy cheeks from the cold wind.
ex.zh: 孩子們被冷風吹得雙頰紅通通地進了屋。

ex.en: The email was a ruse to steal your password.
ex.zh: 那封電子郵件是想騙取你密碼的詭計。

ex.en: He used a clever ruse to get past the guard.
ex.zh: 他用一個巧妙的花招矇混過守衛。

ex.en: He showed up in a rumpled shirt after the long flight.
ex.zh: 長途飛行後，他穿著皺巴巴的襯衫現身。

ex.en: She smoothed the rumpled sheets on the bed.
ex.zh: 她撫平床上皺亂的床單。

rumpled.zh: 弄皺；弄亂（rumple 的過去式）

ex.en: The wind rumpled her hair as she walked along the beach.
ex.zh: 她走在海灘上時，風把她的頭髮吹亂了。

ex.en: He rumpled the paper in his fist and threw it away.
ex.zh: 他把紙握成一團然後丟掉。

ex.en: I have a runny nose and a sore throat.
ex.zh: 我流鼻水，喉嚨也痛。

ex.en: The cold weather gave the child a runny nose.
ex.zh: 寒冷的天氣讓那孩子流起鼻水。

ex.en: The sauce was too runny, so I added some flour.
ex.zh: 醬汁太稀了，所以我加了一點麵粉。

ex.en: He likes his eggs soft and runny.
ex.zh: 他喜歡蛋煮得軟嫩、半流動。

ex.en: The overcooked eggs were rubbery and hard to chew.
ex.zh: 煮過頭的蛋像橡皮一樣有嚼勁，很難咬。

ex.en: This toy has a soft, rubbery texture that babies like.
ex.zh: 這個玩具有柔軟又富彈性的質感，嬰兒很喜歡。

ex.en: The old tire felt rubbery when I pressed it.
ex.zh: 我按壓那條舊輪胎時，感覺像橡膠一樣彈。

ex.en: He rudely interrupted her while she was speaking.
ex.zh: 他在她說話時沒禮貌地打斷了她。

ex.en: The waiter answered rudely, so we complained to the manager.
ex.zh: 服務生回答得很不客氣，所以我們向經理投訴。

ex.en: The CEO was known for his ruthlessness in business.
ex.zh: 那位執行長在商場上以冷酷無情聞名。

ex.en: She was shocked by the ruthlessness of his reply.
ex.zh: 她被他回答中的冷酷嚇到了。

ex.en: The war had a ruinous effect on the country's economy.
ex.zh: 戰爭對該國經濟造成毀滅性的影響。

ex.en: Borrowing money at such a high rate would be ruinous.
ex.zh: 以那麼高的利率借錢會讓人傾家蕩產。

ex.en: The kids made such a ruckus that the neighbors complained.
ex.zh: 孩子們吵得鄰居都來抱怨。

ex.en: A ruckus broke out when the referee ignored the foul.
ex.zh: 裁判無視犯規，引發了一陣騷動。

ex.en: I was shocked by his rudeness to the waiter.
ex.zh: 他對服務生的無禮讓我很震驚。

ex.en: Rudeness is never an acceptable way to win an argument.
ex.zh: 粗魯無禮絕不是贏得爭論的好方法。

ex.en: She looked a little ruffled after the long argument.
ex.zh: 長時間爭論之後，她看起來有點惱火。

ex.en: He tried to smooth his ruffled hair before the interview.
ex.zh: 面試前，他試著撫平凌亂的頭髮。

ex.en: The little girl wore a white dress with a ruffled collar.
ex.zh: 小女孩穿著一件有褶邊領子的白色洋裝。

ex.en: The curtains had ruffled edges that moved in the breeze.
ex.zh: 窗簾有褶皺的邊，隨微風擺動。

ex.en: Don't sit on the bed, you'll rumple the sheets.
ex.zh: 別坐在床上，你會把床單弄皺。

ex.en: The wind rumpled her hair as she rode her bike.
ex.zh: 她騎車時，風把頭髮吹得凌亂。

ex.en: Rudolph is a male given name.
ex.zh: 魯道夫是一個男子名。

ex.en: My friend's dog is named Rudolph.
ex.zh: 我朋友的狗叫做魯道夫。

ex.en: We ran out of milk, so I have to go to the store.
ex.zh: 我們的牛奶喝完了，所以我得去一趟商店。

ex.en: The car will run out of gas if we don't stop soon.
ex.zh: 如果我們不趕快停下來，車子就要沒油了。

ex.en: Hurry up, or we will run out of time.
ex.zh: 快一點，不然我們時間就不夠了。

ex.en: I ran into my old teacher at the supermarket yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天在超市巧遇我以前的老師。

ex.en: You'll never guess who I ran into on the train!
ex.zh: 你絕對猜不到我在火車上遇到誰！

ex.en: She ran into a former classmate while traveling in Japan.
ex.zh: 她在日本旅行時碰到一位以前的同學。

ex.en: The car ran into a tree after skidding on the wet road.
ex.zh: 那輛車在濕滑的路面打滑後撞上了一棵樹。

ex.en: Be careful not to run into the glass door.
ex.zh: 小心別撞上那道玻璃門。

ex.en: The little boy ran into the table and started crying.
ex.zh: 小男孩撞到桌子，哭了起來。

ex.en: We ran into some problems while building the website.
ex.zh: 我們在架設網站時遇到了一些問題。

ex.en: The company ran into trouble after its main supplier closed.
ex.zh: 主要供應商倒閉後，這間公司陷入了困境。

ex.en: If you run into any difficulty, just ask me.
ex.zh: 如果你遇到任何困難，儘管問我。

ex.en: The repair costs could run into thousands of dollars.
ex.zh: 維修費用可能高達數千元。

ex.en: Losses from the storm ran into millions.
ex.zh: 這場風暴造成的損失高達數百萬。

ex.en: The waiting list for the clinic runs into hundreds of names.
ex.zh: 那間診所的候補名單多達數百人。
